A father in his sixties writes that he is unsure whether he is in the wrong. He sets out the background: a marriage that was struggling, a daughter he was close to, and a mistake he still regrets.
Years after the divorce, his daughter cut off contact. He describes what happened when she reached out again, and what he said in reply — the remark that prompted the question in the headline.
